tasks.title: Bus route changes
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs Hill, and the notes you have made.

Write your email to Mrs Hill using all the notes.

promptBlocks.subject: Bus route changes in our area
paragraphs: As you know, the bus company wants to change the route that serves our three villages. Some people want the bus to stop at the new supermarket, but others want it to go directly to the train station. Which option do you think is better? Why?
Also, what time should the first bus leave in the morning?
Finally, do you think the fare should be lower for students?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Choose supermarket or train station – say why.
Suggest a time for the first bus.
Give your opinion on student fares.
Ask Mrs Hill one question about the changes.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Bus route changes – your opinion
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

You see this notice on a village website.

Write your article.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our village magazine wants to hear your opinion about the bus route changes.
Do you think the new bus route will help people in our three villages?
What is the most important thing the bus company should improve?
Write an article answering these questions and we will publish it in the next issue!

tasks.title: A bus journey
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

Your story must begin with this sentence:

"When the bus finally arrived, it was already full of people from the other villages."

Write your story.

promptBlocks.text:
